One-line description: Payments and invoice financing for Indian SMEs.
What have you built?: A payments platform for SMEs with payment links, collections reconciliation and invoice financing funded by NBFC partners.
Volume and revenue: INR 86 Cr payment volume in October 2026. Net revenue INR 78 L.
Unit economics: CAC INR 14,500 per SME, payback 7 months, gross margin 58%, net revenue retention 112%.
Customer acquisition: CA and accountant partners 40%, direct sales 35%, inbound and referrals 25%.
Key risks: Credit losses on financed invoices, dependence on NBFC partners, regulation of digital lending.
Existing investors: INR 9 Cr seed round in 2024, led by two institutional funds.
Use of funds: Financing book, sales and distribution, product, risk and compliance.
Anything else we should know?: We are looking for a lead investor for our Series A.
Founder background: Rahul Mehta (CEO): 10 years in transaction banking; led SME product at a private bank. Sonal Iyer (CTO): 8 years in payments engineering at a large fintech.
